_meta.usage: Rivalry logos are for display on frontporchsports.com only. They must never be used on FrontPorchSports.shop merchandise or any other product. Most are non-free (fair use) marks; see each entry's license.
_meta.source: Extracted from the RIVALRIES literal previously inlined in index.html and compare.html; extended 2026-10 from Wikipedia 'List of NCAA college football rivalry games' and each rivalry article (MediaWiki API).
_meta.keyFormat: The two dataset team names (data/derived/manifest.json 'names'), alphabetically sorted, joined by '|'. Lookups still accent-fold both sides.
_meta.fields: name (display), also_known_as, team1/team2 (dataset names), trophy, logo (path or null), wikipedia_url, wikimedia_file_url, license (as listed on the file page), sponsor_branded, sponsor, status and last_meeting (DERIVED - scripts/build_rivalries.py writes them from front_porch_games.json and schedules_data.json; never edit by hand), status_override ({status, reason, source} for known cases the data cannot see, e.g. a formally paused series), logo_light (true = mostly white/light, rendered on a gray backing circle). tier: 1 = the 64 rivalries the site featured before the 2026-10 expansion (full +35 featured-matchup bonus), 2 = every other named rivalry (+10). source: only where the logo has no Wikipedia/Wikimedia file page ("owner supplied" = provided by the site owner, origin not documented). trophy_source: official page naming the FOOTBALL trophy (school athletics site / media guide / university; Wikipedia only as a fallback), or confirming there is none. trophy_verified: true = checked against that source (2026-10 audit of tier 1); false = unchecked (tier 2) or the schools disagree (see trophy_note). A null trophy means no football trophy: all-sports series trophies and retired trophies are not shown. trophy_source_2: a second official source where the schools name the trophy differently.

Oklahoma|Oklahoma St..name: Bedlam
Oklahoma|Oklahoma St..trophy_note: Bell clapper from Old Central was the football trophy starting in 1966; the tradition continues as the crystal bell awarded to the winner of every Bedlam sport.

BYU|Utah St..name: BYU–Utah State
BYU|Utah St..trophy: The Old Wagon Wheel; Beehive Boot

Florida|Florida St..name: Florida–Florida State Rivalry
Florida|Florida St..trophy_note: No head-to-head trophy. The Florida Cup is a three-way round-robin award among Florida, Florida State and Miami with no official source (no school athletics page or game notes name it), so it is not shown.

Florida|Miami.name: Florida–Miami Rivalry
Florida|Miami.trophy_note: No head-to-head trophy. The Florida Cup is a three-way round-robin award among Florida, Florida State and Miami with no official source (no school athletics page or game notes name it), so it is not shown. The Seminole War Canoe trophy was retired in the 1970s.

Illinois|Purdue.trophy_note: Same trophy, two official names: Illinois calls it the "Purdue Cannon" (fightingillini.com), Purdue the "Cannon Trophy" (purduesports.com). Displayed as "Purdue Cannon".
